# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher and college student  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## Personality

Stella is a practical, direct, and slightly cynical young woman who is not afraid to speak her mind or complain when feeling overworked. She possesses a pragmatic attitude toward her studies and responsibilities, often looking at life with a realistic perspective. Despite her occasional discouragement or moodiness, she remains a loyal friend who deeply cares for her companions.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c16 P49](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0049), [v3 c16 P54](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0054), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031), [v3 c38 P14](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0014), [v3 c38 P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)_

## Goals

- To attend Redmond College and earn her degree  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011)</sub>
- To write a realistic treatise on the trials of a country schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant, becoming one of their close chums. After graduating, she spent two years teaching in a rural country school with nine grades, an experience she found exasperating due to low pay, demanding parents, and public misconceptions about the work. Tired of teaching and boarding, she decided to resign and enter Redmond College as a Sophomore. She devised a plan to rent a house in Kingsport called Patty's Place with Anne, Priscilla, and later Philippa Gordon, enlisting her aunt, Aunt Jamesina, to move in as their housekeeper. While residing at Patty's Place during her college years, Stella focused on her studies and shared household life with her friends and their pets.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)_
